subject: PO number issuance, spend-cap allocation, and requested line-item split (BrightBridge)
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@brightbridge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: PO number issuance, spend-cap allocation, and requested line-item split (BrightBridge)

Hi Liam —

Welcome to Redwood. We're finishing BrightBridge's procurement onboarding and need one quick confirmation so our finance team can accept your invoices without delays. Attached is a provisional PO we generated while the vendor portal sync completes. Two items to confirm:

1) Line-item split: our contract separates "Platform Consumption" and "Priority Support" billing. Can you confirm BrightBridge prefers two invoice lines (consumption + support) rather than a single rolled-up invoice? If yes, please confirm the SKU mapping you want for each line (your system SKU + brief description).

2) Spend cap: per the signed SOW the monthly spend cap is $60,000. We'll issue PO RBW-2026-45321 to reflect the contractual cap and then allow overage approval routing if you anticipate monthly spikes. Please flag now if you need a different immediate cap.

I've cc'd Ben and Karthik from procurement so they can issue the final PO number and confirm accounting details. If you could reply today with the SKU mapping and whether you want split lines, we'll finalize the PO and send the PDF.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Sr. Program Manager, Vendor Onboarding
Redwood Inference

Attachment: RBW_provisional_PO_draft.xlsx (attachment stub)
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@brightbridge.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightBridge Finance <finance@brightbridge.com>
Date: 2026-09-19T12:35:00-04:00
Subject: Re: PO number issuance, spend-cap allocation, and requested line-item split (BrightBridge)

Hi Grace —

Thanks — we prefer a two-line invoice:
- BB-CONS-001: Platform consumption (metered tokens)
- BB-SUP-005: Priority support (monthly)

Our accounting system needs the PO number in the header and each invoice line to include our internal SKU to auto-map. I've attached the invoice we attempted to submit earlier (BrightBridge_invoice_7890.pdf) — you can see how our system expects items to be structured. We can accept RBW-2026-45321 as long as the PO is returned as a PDF and the line items map to the SKUs above.

One quick note: our monthly forecasting shows a potential peak in month 2 around $72k. If you can mark the PO with the standard overage-approval workflow, that will avoid hold-ups on our side.

Best,
Liam O'Connor
Head of Partnerships
BrightBridge

Attachment: BrightBridge_invoice_7890.pdf (attachment stub)

- PO number: RBW-2026-45321
- Effective spend cap (monthly): $60,000 per SOW; overage approvals route to procurement@redwood.com for ad-hoc increases.
- Line items (please map to BrightBridge SKUs):
  * Line 1 (Consumption): RBW-L1 / amount: variable / map to BB-CONS-001
  * Line 2 (Support): RBW-L2 / amount: $10,000 monthly (recurring) / map to BB-SUP-005

Action items: 
- Liam / BrightBridge Finance: confirm receipt of attached PO PDF and confirm you can map BB-CONS-001 / BB-SUP-005 to your system.
- Grace: once confirmed I'll update SAP and the vendor portal; Priya please confirm GL codes for both lines so finance can route correctly.

I'll also put a short comment in PROC-9876 in Jira with the PO number and attachments.
